text: Level three, question six: a trader sells forty percent of his stock, by cost, at a ten percent profit; at what profit percent must he sell the rest, to make sixteen percent overall? Question seven: one hundred and twenty items are bought at fifty rupees each; twenty are damaged and cannot be sold; at what price must each remaining item be sold, to make a twenty percent profit overall? Question eight: three quarters of the goods, by cost, are sold at a twenty percent profit, and the rest at cost price; find the overall profit percent.
